name: GET /api/leadflow/kpi-definitions - the registry
description: Every current metric definition (44fa2588-4db3-48f4-a653-2c0a970f94fc#AC1). This is the list a dashboard tile must reference to ship - the read side of the enforcement rule, so a builder can see what already exists before adding a metric that means almost the same thing under a different name, which is how two dashboards start disagreeing in the first place. QA: reads the definition registered earlier in the chain.

testCases.name: The current definitions are returned with their required fields
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
